description: Auto-emit one Dagster asset per Cognos report by enumerating reports in the specified folders via the Cognos Analytics REST API. StateBackedComponent — discovery cached to disk. Materializing an asset runs the underlying report. The workspace-shape peer of the cognos_* low-level components.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per selected item discovered in the vendor. See README for what each materialization produces.

folder_ids.label: Folder IDs (searchPaths)
folder_ids.description: Cognos folder searchPaths to enumerate. Omit for root.

report_selector.label: Report Selector
report_selector.description: Fivetran-shape selector: by_name / by_pattern / exclude_by_name / exclude_by_pattern.

group_name.description: Group name for all imported assets.
group_name.label: Group Name

asset_key_prefix.description: Key prefix used for all emitted AssetKeys.
asset_key_prefix.label: Asset Key Prefix

compute_kind.description: Compute kind tag for all imported assets.
compute_kind.label: Compute Kind

wait_for_completion.description: If true, block until the report run completes.
wait_for_completion.label: Wait for Completion

timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for a report run to complete.
timeout_seconds.label: Timeout (s)

defs_state.description: State backend for cached workspace discovery. Local filesystem by default. Overridden per-deploy for prod runs against Dagster Cloud.
defs_state.label: Defs State Config
